SiN

This was back in the late 1990's. This is one of the best examples you will ever see of a developer panicking.

SiN was poised to be a revolutionary game, one that would redefine what it meant to be a gamer.

Until Unreal came out first.

The developer noticed, and rushed to complete the game, and ended up shipping it not long after Unreal was released. The game was every bit inferior to Unreal, and had numerous game-breaking and crash bugs that soured player reception.
